businessId.meta.title: What is a Business ID? — BlockID.au
businessId.meta.description: A Business ID bundles verified identity, evidence and capabilities into one reusable record. Five verification levels, 13-area analysis, consent-based sharing.
businessId.headline: One Business. One Trusted Identity.
businessId.subhead: A Business ID is a verified digital identity that carries your evidence, verification level and capabilities — so investors, procurement teams and grant panels can trust what you claim, without re-verifying it every time.
businessId.what.title: What a Business ID is
businessId.what.intro: Four ingredients bundled into one reusable record — verified once, presented on your terms, revocable at any time.
businessId.what.identity.title: Verified identity
businessId.what.identity.body: ASIC/ABR/ABN checked, directors matched, domain and email owner confirmed. The identity anchor for everything else on your profile.
businessId.what.evidence.title: Evidence
businessId.what.evidence.body: Traction, financials, contracts, IP — stored encrypted, hash-anchored in an audit log, cited inline in your Trust Report.
businessId.what.capabilities.title: Capabilities
businessId.what.capabilities.body: What your business can actually do — sector, offering, team skills, tooling — scored on the 13-area rubric.
businessId.what.reusable.title: Reusable
businessId.what.reusable.body: One record, many share packages. Send a signed link to an investor today, a buyer tomorrow, a grant panel next week — always current, never re-typed.
businessId.levels.title: Five verification levels
businessId.levels.intro: Each level adds a checkable claim on top of the previous one. Public /id/{slug} profiles surface the badge for the level you have reached.
businessId.level1.title: L1 — Self-declared
businessId.level1.body: You have created a Business ID with a name, jurisdiction hint and email. Not sufficient for a public profile.
businessId.level2.title: L2 — Identity verified
businessId.level2.body: ASIC/ABR/ABN record matched, domain ownership confirmed, email owner verified. Minimum bar for a public /id/{slug} profile.
businessId.level3.title: L3 — Financials attested
businessId.level3.body: Financial statements attested by a qualified accountant (CA/CPA/IPA in AU, equivalent overseas). Practical bar for investor and procurement diligence.
businessId.level4.title: L4 — Independently audited
businessId.level4.body: Financial statements audited by an independent registered auditor. Required for Series A+ diligence and material procurement contracts.
businessId.level5.title: L5 — Cross-jurisdictional
businessId.level5.body: Evidence and verification present in a second jurisdiction (used by the AU-VN corridor cohort). Includes DKKD/MST alongside ASIC/ABR.
businessId.pillars.title: 13-area analysis — 4 pillars
businessId.pillars.intro: The same 13-area rubric applies to every Business ID. Investors compare apples with apples; founders know exactly which areas need evidence.
businessId.pillar1.title: Leadership & People
businessId.pillar1.a2: Culture, org design and hiring pipeline
businessId.pillar2.title: Strategy & Commercial
businessId.pillar3.title: Ops & Performance
businessId.pillar4.title: Tech & Digital
businessId.sharing.title: How sharing works
businessId.sharing.consent.title: Consent-based
businessId.sharing.consent.body: Nothing on your Business ID leaves your control unless you create a share package. Each package selects specific evidence and audiences.
businessId.sharing.expiry.title: Time-limited
businessId.sharing.expiry.body: Every share link carries an expiry (default 30 days). Recipients see a countdown. After expiry, the link 404s — no accidental long tails.
businessId.sharing.revocation.title: Revocable, audited
businessId.sharing.revocation.body: Revoke instantly at any time. Every view is logged with timestamp, IP, and (if the viewer is signed in) their Business ID — hash-chained for tamper evidence.
businessId.badge.title: Badge widget
businessId.badge.intro: Embed your verified badge on your website, LinkedIn or email signature. Renders your current verification level, last update date, and a link to your public /id/{slug} profile — updates in real time when your level changes.
businessId.badge.caption: Sample badge: Verified Business ID · Level 3 · updated Jul 2026. Copy the embed snippet from your dashboard.
businessId.cta.title: Create Your Business ID
businessId.disclaimer: Nothing on this page is financial or legal advice. Verification confirms what the record says, not the underlying business decision. Auschain PTY LTD · ACN 659 615 111 · ABN 79 659 615 111 · Sydney NSW.
meta.solutions.founder.title: For founders — score your startup and see what it is worth | BlockID.au
meta.solutions.founder.description: Paste an idea, a link or a pitch deck. Get a Startup Value Index score across eight dimensions, a valuation range with the working behind it, and your next steps in priority order. The first run is free.
solutions.founder.headline: Score your startup, and see what it is worth.
solutions.founder.persona: Paste an idea, a URL or a pitch deck. You get a Startup Value Index score across eight dimensions, a valuation range with the working behind it, and your next steps in the order they are worth doing. The first run costs nothing.
solutions.founder.benefits.title: What you get, rung by rung
solutions.founder.benefit1.title: The first run is free
solutions.founder.benefit1.body: Paste an idea, a URL or a deck and read your score and valuation range on screen, before anything is asked of you. Want it in writing? A {freePages}-page summary is emailed to you, yours to forward. No card, and a one-click unsubscribe on every email we send.
solutions.founder.benefit2.title: The full report for {reportPrice}, without an account
solutions.founder.benefit2.body: A one-off guest checkout, GST-inclusive, with an ATO tax invoice. Ten pages or more: the valuation methods and where they disagree, a page per dimension with the reasoning rather than only the number, the risk landscape, and a 90-day plan. It arrives by email, usually within a few minutes.
solutions.founder.benefit3.title: {founderPrice} a month when you want to keep it
solutions.founder.benefit3.body: Your score tracked over time instead of one snapshot, a data room that fills up in the order investors ask, a live link you share instead of a PDF that goes stale, and {founderCredits} AI credits a month to re-run it as things change.
solutions.founder.journey.title: What the first 90 days look like

solutions.founder.journey.step1.b1: Paste an idea, a URL or a pitch deck and read the score on screen.
solutions.founder.journey.step1.b2: Have the {freePages}-page summary emailed to you, to forward on.
solutions.founder.journey.step1.b3: Unlock the full report for {reportPrice} when you want the working behind the number.
solutions.founder.journey.step2.head: Work the gaps it names
solutions.founder.journey.step2.b1: Take the next steps in the order the report puts them.
solutions.founder.journey.step2.b2: Re-run as things change — on {founderPrice} a month your score is kept and tracked.
solutions.founder.journey.step2.b3: Fill your data room in the order investors ask for it.
solutions.founder.journey.step3.head: Put it in front of people
solutions.founder.journey.step3.b1: Share a live investor link instead of a PDF that goes stale.
solutions.founder.journey.step3.b2: Publish a consent-gated public profile at /listings/{slug} if you want to be found.
solutions.founder.journey.step3.b3: On {growthPrice} a month, model the cap table and draft a term sheet.
solutions.founder.faq.title: Frequently asked
solutions.founder.faq.q1: What does the free run actually give me?
solutions.founder.faq.a1: Your score across eight dimensions and a valuation range, on screen, before anything is asked of you. Give us an email address and the same thing arrives as a {freePages}-page written summary you can forward. Every email carries a one-click unsubscribe.
solutions.founder.faq.q2: Do I need an account to buy the full report?
solutions.founder.faq.a2: No. The {reportPrice} report is a guest checkout — pay, give us your deck or your URL, and it arrives by email. The price is GST-inclusive, so the price you see is the price you pay, and every charge produces an ATO tax invoice. An account only starts to matter when you want the score kept and tracked.
solutions.founder.faq.q3: What is the difference between {founderPrice} and {growthPrice} a month?
solutions.founder.faq.a3: {founderPrice} keeps your score on your account and tracks it over time, and gives you the data room, a live investor share link and {founderCredits} AI credits a month. {growthPrice} adds the cap table with SAFE and option modelling, share management, the investor pack and the term-sheet drafter, on {growthCredits} credits a month. ESOP administration, vesting schedules and on-chain sync are a separate {equityAddon} a month add-on on top of a paid plan.
solutions.founder.disclaimer: Not financial or legal advice. A Startup Value Index score and valuation range are generated from the information you give us; investors, buyers and grant panels remain responsible for their own due diligence. Auschain PTY LTD · ACN 659 615 111 · ABN 79 659 615 111 · Sydney NSW.
meta.solutions.investor.title: For investors — every startup on the same eight dimensions | BlockID.au
meta.solutions.investor.description: Open a founder's data room from a share link, with no account. Every startup is scored on the same eight dimensions, so a first pass compares like with like.
solutions.investor.headline: Read a founder's data room without asking them for anything.
solutions.investor.persona: A founder sends a link; you open the data room and the report behind it, read-only, without creating an account. Every startup here is scored on the same eight dimensions, so a first pass compares like with like instead of comparing decks.
solutions.investor.benefits.title: What is actually here for you
solutions.investor.benefit1.title: One rubric across every deal
solutions.investor.benefit1.body: Every score on the platform is the same eight dimensions, produced the same way: founder and team, market and problem clarity, product and technical depth, traction and revenue evidence, cap table and governance, investor readiness, legal and compliance, and strategic vision. A founder cannot pick a flattering framing, and you are not re-deriving a rubric per company.
solutions.investor.benefit2.title: Open the room from the link
solutions.investor.benefit2.body: A founder's share link opens a read-only data room in your browser — no account, no software, nothing to install. The founder can expire or revoke it, and the view is logged for their audit trail rather than kept as a profile of you.
solutions.investor.benefit3.title: Run your own pass on anything
solutions.investor.benefit3.body: Paste a company's site or its deck and run the analysis yourself. Score and valuation range free on screen, the full written report for {reportPrice} as a one-off guest checkout — no subscription, and an ATO tax invoice on the charge.
solutions.investor.faq.title: Frequently asked
solutions.investor.faq.q1: Do I need an account to read a report a founder sent me?
solutions.investor.faq.a1: No. The link is the credential: it opens a read-only data room in the browser. A revoked, expired or wrong link all look the same, so the page never confirms a room exists to someone who does not hold the link.
solutions.investor.faq.a2: Founder and team, market and problem clarity, product and technical depth, traction and revenue evidence, cap table and governance health, investor readiness, legal and compliance, and strategic vision. Each is scored with its reasoning attached, so you can disagree with a particular judgement rather than with the whole number.
solutions.investor.faq.q3: Is a score a substitute for diligence?
solutions.investor.faq.a3: No. It is a triage layer built from what the founder gave us and what is publicly available. Nothing on the platform is financial or investment advice, and every decision remains yours.
solutions.investor.disclaimer: Not financial, investment or legal advice. Scores and valuation ranges are generated from founder-supplied and publicly available information; investment decisions remain your own. Auschain PTY LTD · ACN 659 615 111 · ABN 79 659 615 111 · Sydney NSW.
meta.solutions.accelerator.title: For accelerators — run a cohort on one scoring rubric | BlockID.au
meta.solutions.accelerator.description: A workspace and a score per founder on the same eight dimensions, score history company by company, and a mentor roster with check-ins and notes beside it.
solutions.accelerator.headline: Run a cohort on one scoring rubric.
solutions.accelerator.persona: Give every founder in your programme a workspace and a score on the same eight dimensions, keep a mentor roster with check-ins and notes beside it, and follow the movement company by company rather than from memory.
solutions.accelerator.benefits.title: What a programme gets today
solutions.accelerator.benefit1.title: A workspace per startup, one rubric
solutions.accelerator.benefit1.body: Every company in the cohort is scored on the same eight dimensions, so you can put two of them side by side and the comparison holds.
solutions.accelerator.benefit2.title: Score history, company by company
solutions.accelerator.benefit2.body: Each startup keeps its score over time, so movement between sessions is something you can see rather than something you have to remember.
solutions.accelerator.benefit3.title: A mentor roster that is wired up
solutions.accelerator.benefit3.body: Roster, check-ins and shared notes on each founder. Cohort management, batch scoring across a whole cohort and a packaged report for sponsors are in build — ask us where they are up to before you plan around them.
solutions.accelerator.journey.title: What a cohort's first 90 days look like
solutions.accelerator.journey.step1.head: Set the cohort up
solutions.accelerator.journey.step1.b1: Create a workspace for each startup and run its first score.
solutions.accelerator.journey.step1.b2: Assign mentors — roster, check-ins and notes sit beside the score.
solutions.accelerator.journey.step1.b3: Read the gaps the first scores name across the whole cohort.
solutions.accelerator.journey.step2.head: Work the gaps
solutions.accelerator.journey.step2.b1: Run sessions against the dimensions the cohort scores worst on.
solutions.accelerator.journey.step2.b2: Fill each company's data room in the order investors ask for it.
solutions.accelerator.journey.step2.b3: Re-run the scores and compare them against the first pass.
solutions.accelerator.journey.step3.head: Demo day
solutions.accelerator.journey.step3.b1: Each founder shares a live investor link instead of a PDF.
solutions.accelerator.journey.step3.b2: Publish the founders who consent to a public profile at /listings/{slug}.
solutions.accelerator.journey.step3.b3: Assemble a sponsor update from each company's own report.
solutions.accelerator.faq.title: Frequently asked
solutions.accelerator.faq.q1: Can we score a whole cohort in one run?
solutions.accelerator.faq.a1: Not yet. Each startup is scored in its own workspace today, and batch scoring across a cohort is in build. If cohort size is the deciding factor for you, tell us how many companies you run and we will tell you honestly where it is up to.
solutions.accelerator.faq.q2: Can our sponsors or LPs see the underlying startups?
solutions.accelerator.faq.a2: Only what you or the founder chooses to share — nothing leaves a startup's workspace on its own. There is no packaged sponsor or LP report yet; today you would assemble one from each company's own report.
solutions.accelerator.faq.q3: How does pricing work for a programme?
solutions.accelerator.faq.a3: Programme pricing is sized around the number of companies rather than the number of programmes, and it is a conversation rather than a card on the pricing page. The founder ladder underneath is public: a free first run, {reportPrice} for a full report, then {founderPrice} or {growthPrice} a month for a workspace that keeps the score.
solutions.accelerator.disclaimer: Not financial or legal advice. BlockID.au is an analysis and reporting platform, not a placement agent. Auschain PTY LTD · ACN 659 615 111 · ABN 79 659 615 111 · Sydney NSW.
